purpose: Stage 0.5, retry round (user decision 2026-11-18): the Agent column alone on the 13 ready A_static instances, with a guard stop fed back to the brain as the node's failure and up to 2 retries per episode, each resuming the failed node's entry checkpoint in a new branch (harness/agent_column.py agent-column-p3-g0-retry-20261118; §2.1.1 snapshot return, simulation privilege). Brain changed to GPT-6.2 Astra via local Magpie (user decision 2026-11-18). No growth: the graph stays G0. Measures what retries over G0 recover, first pass and after retries counted apart.
instance_note: Same generate spec and seeds as A_static (replicates), so prepare rebuilds the same 18 instances and the same 13 ready ones; ready rows and initial hashes are compared with A_static after prepare.

baselines.negative: 2 s wait on the first ready instance of each template under hand rule v2; any goal satisfaction invalidates the whole batch
baselines.agent_static: outputs/tabletop_astatic_20261117_001 agent column (DeepSeek v4.1 flash, no retry, a guard ended the episode): 2/13 full success (TP01 2/5, TP03 0/2, TP04 0/6)
baselines.engineering: outputs/tabletop_astatic_20261117_001 engineering column on the same instances: 2/13
baselines.confound: brain model and retry change together; the first pass approximates A_static under Astra (its prompt also carries the retry rule), success after retries minus first pass is the retry effect

caps_note: Simulation and command budgets follow a branch's lineage (a branch resumes its source prefix), so A_static's per-episode values stay; wall restarts per branch. brain_calls bounds all decisions of an episode across branches. 2 forks: over G0 the only different retry is another locate method or query.
budget_note: 3 negatives + 13 ready instances x 1 arm; a retry branch is part of its episode, not a new physical episode.
prediction: No system failure, no KERNEL_CHANGED_AFTER_PREPARE, negatives 3/3 not satisfied; the 13 ready instances and their robot initial hashes equal A_static's.

Cross-run determinism: on every instance whose first-pass executed node path (calls and args) equals the A_static agent episode's, the physical records (integration and boundary states, actions.json, tools.json) are equal to A_static's.
First pass: at most 3 full successes (A_static 2/13; the grasp frontier is physical, not a decision).
Retry: Astra retries on at least half of the instances whose first pass failed at grasp, and every executed retry branch changes the locate (method or query) before grasping again.

Retries recover at most 2 instances (success after retries <= first-pass successes + 2): 9 of A_static's 11 grasp failures were guard stops at translate_clear, forward_clear_18 or lift pressure, which a few-millimetre locate change is not expected to remove.
At most 1 AgentSchemaError; no BRAIN_CALL_BUDGET; every episode's last branch ends with stop (done or give_up).
falsification: Negative control satisfies a goal, or any system failure: the whole batch is invalid.

An instance with the same first-pass node path as A_static whose physical records differ: hidden state, nondeterminism or a replication mismatch; retry results are not used for item 6 until the cause is found.
Any BRAIN_CALL_BUDGET or more than 1 AgentSchemaError: the retry prompt or schema is not usable for item 6 as is; reported, not fixed inside this run.
A retry branch whose restored prefix differs from its source episode up to the resumed checkpoint (integration states): the branch mechanism is broken; success after retries is not reported.
interpretation: If success after retries equals the first pass, the G0 grasp frontier is not addressable by locate choice: item 6 then needs leaf growth (§2.1.1 step 4), not more retries.
